text:
deploybot: Heads up — canary rollout for runtime v3.2.1 is scheduled 03:00 UTC. Telemetry spike on llama-q3b longseq (>2048): throughput degradation + increased errors. Recommendation: soft-pin runtime 3.2.1 for llama-q3b and route longseq traffic to 3.1.9 until hotfix. @sanjay @maria please advise.

maria: I saw the same spike. Soft-pin sounds right. What is the expected impact on Dedicated customers and on SDK compatibility?

sanjay: SDK note: clients on SDK 2.14 expect new KV cache headers. If we route to 3.1.9, some KV warmup semantics differ but shim can cover it. I can flip shim flag quickly.

nora: QA: we saw small correctness diffs when we ran 3.2.1 on longseq tests — pretty minor, but throughput regression is the big user-facing issue. Suggest 20m canary hold then decide.

deploybot: Command to enact soft-pin (dry-run example):
```
deploybot pin-runtime --model llama-q3b --runtime 3.2.1 --scope canary,staging --type soft --fallback 3.1.9
```
This will route new longseq sessions to 3.1.9, leave short sessions on 3.2.1.

olivia: +1 from me. Can we add an auto-unpin guard: if error_rate < 0.5% for 6h then auto-unpin, else manual review?

juan: Note: Dedicated pools aren't affected by hosted routing changes if customers pinned to commits. We'll ping any Dedicated customers running long-running jobs.

qa-bot: Preflight results: 3 integration tests failing on kvcache warmup in staging. Snippet from logs: `kvcache: warmup overflow at seq=2049` — attaching full trace to thread.

sanjay: I'm enabling SDK_SHIM_KVCACHE=true in staging to mitigate warmup differences. ETA ~12m. Will run quick e2e.

maria: Approving soft-pin. Proposed change window 02:50–03:10 UTC. @deploybot proceed once shim confirmed. Also please update release notes / compatibility blurb.

sanjay: Shim is enabled in staging and sanity passes. No regressions on shortseq. Ready to proceed.

deploybot: Soft-pin executed at 1738804460 (03:02:40 UTC). Routing rules applied to canary and staging. Monitoring for the next 60m.

deploybot: Telemetry update (15m): longseq error rate on canary down from 2.8% -> 0.4%. Throughput recovered to baseline. Holding for 1h before full rollback/unpin decision.

theo: For release notes, add: “Temporary soft-pin applied for llama-q3b long sequence workloads due to runtime 3.2.1 quant throughput regression. SDK shim enabled to preserve KV warmup semantics; users on SDK <2.14 may observe slight latency changes.”

maria: I'll draft and post the note to #release-notes and ping comms. Thanks all.

deploybot: Marking thread monitored. Reopen if rollback required. :white_check_mark:
